state.goal: Real quality benchmarks for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 (QAD checkpoint) served on 2x DGX Spark: primary build b1.2 (currently serving), comparison build b1 (older image, same checkpoint; differences are kernel/precision changes: HC mixers MXFP8, prefix-drop, deferred GDN checkpoints already in b1). User requires: Aider polyglot (225), MMLU-Pro ~2000 stratified subset unless full fits, GSM8K full 1319, IFEval full 541, LiveCodeBench recent window, DevOps set of 14 prompts. b1 is REQUIRED for MMLU-Pro subset, GSM8K, IFEval, DevOps; OPTIONAL for Aider and LCB if time is short. User wants real benchmarks, works autonomously, no hard deadline stated, results only.

measured.aggregate_decode_tok_s: about 215 tok/s at 9 concurrent thinking-mode requests (temp 1.0, MTP acceptance ~2.7); max_num_seqs 16; c16 maybe ~300
measured.gsm8k_smoke: 16 q: 15/16, ~370 tokens/q, 2.3 s/q at c8 -> full set ~50 min
measured.mmlu_pro_smoke: 42 q (3/subject): 88.1%, ~4.6 s/q at c8 steady, long tail; estimate ~1500 tokens/q -> 2000 q about 3-4 h per build, 1000 q about 1.5-2 h, full 12032 about 20 h
measured.lcb_window: release_v6 problems 2025-02-01..2025-04-06 = 131 (31 easy/39 medium/61 hard), matching the vendor's LCB v6 window; hard problems think 15-30k tokens; estimate ~2 h per build at c8
measured.aider: 225 exercises, 2 tries, thinking on, diff format; estimate 2-3 h per build at 8 threads
measured.ifeval_devops: IFEval ~40 min; DevOps 14 prompts x 3 repeats at c1 ~50 min
measured.switch_cost: warm boot of either build ~1-4 min plus health/pong
measured.estimated_totals: b1.2 all evals ~9 h; b1 required set ~5 h with 2000 MMLU-Pro (3.5 h with 1000); b1 aider+LCB would add ~4-5 h

state.statistics: MMLU-Pro accuracy ~80%: SE 0.9 pt at n=2000, 1.3 pt at n=1000; paired McNemar on identical questions tightens the build difference. Sampling temp 1.0 adds per-question noise. Quantization/kernel regressions of interest are ~1-2 pt.
